hypothesis: A BytesView borrowed parameter can be compositionally reborrowed through direct synchronous call chains of depth 1-3 without lifetime syntax, ownership duplication, allocation, payload copy, reference counting, or escape beyond the originating chain.
competing_explanations: Descriptor passing looks zero-copy only because ownership ancestry is absent from HIR/MIR.
Inlining can erase reborrow boundaries or their end order.
A child descriptor may silently outlive its parent even when native execution happens to succeed.
Conditional control flow may terminate child reborrows on only one path.
falsifier: Any lifetime annotation, new owner, allocation, free, payload copy, retain/release, escaping child, child ending after parent, owner access before the full chain ends, lost optimized metadata, branch imbalance, sanitizer violation, valid<256, invalid<192, or full-suite failure prevents PASS.
minimal_change: Permit immutable BytesView parameter forwarding only across non-recursive direct synchronous calls to depth three and add versioned reborrow evidence extensions.
required_evidence: surface/HIR/MIR/native differential corpus, exact negative diagnostics, no-inline ABI per level, optimized assembly, structural allocation/copy/RC counters, ASan/UBSan/LSan, one full suite, frozen hashes.
stop_condition: Stop on confirmed safety defect; otherwise choose exactly one preregistered status after one Decision Run.
